management_steps.details: Topical lotion, 25%. For children < 1 year: dilute 1 part to 3 parts water to form 6% emulsion. For children 1 to 6 years: dilute 1 part with equal amount of water to form 12.5% emulsion.

Body lice: apply undiluted once weekly for 3 weeks. Pubic lice: apply once weekly for 2 weeks, repeat in 7 days. Scabies (children < 6 years): apply diluted emulsion neck to feet overnight. Scabies (children >= 6 years and adults): apply undiluted to whole body from neck to feet for 24 hours.
Toxic if swallowed. Avoid eyes and broken skin or sores. Do not continue if rash or swelling develops.

warnings: Toxic if swallowed. Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin or sores.
